name: recording-ui-evidence
title_zh: 界面改动录成 GIF 证据，直接贴进变更单
tagline_zh: 改完界面没人信你「已经好了」？它按固定节奏录下可复现的操作序列，输出带起止帧的 GIF，直接贴进变更单。
tagline_en: Nobody believes your UI fix without proof. It records a repeatable interaction sequence into a GIF with clear.
desc_en: Use when recording a browser or UI interaction demo as a GIF, when a change alters interface behavior a user can see and needs visual evidence, or when attaching a demo GIF to a change request. DO NOT invoke for a single static screenshot — none of this applies to one image.
why_zh: 录的是操作序列不是单帧截图，评审能看到前后状态和中间过程，争议点当场消失。
why_en: It captures the interaction sequence, not a single frame, so reviewers see before, after, and the steps between.
limit_zh: 只做动态演示：单张静态截图它直接拒绝，别拿它当截图工具。录的是浏览器/UI 交互，终端命令、日志。
limit_en: GIF demos only — it refuses single static screenshots. Browser/UI interactions only; terminal, logs, and API responses can't be captured. Size and.
title_en: UI change recorded as a GIF evidence clip
